summary: This is an 8-K filed by SS&C Technologies Holdings Inc reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Items covered include stockholder approval of a Third Amended and Restated 2023 Stock Incentive Plan (adding 10 million shares), election of three Class I directors, advisory approval of executive compensation, and ratification of the independent auditor. The filing also notes the board's prior approval of the plan. There are no special-situation events—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, liquidation, or other transformative corporate action. The items are routine governance and equity plan matters.
